verdict.rationale: Zep is an API-driven SaaS, so a downloadable machine-readable API spec is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions an OpenAPI or equivalent spec file. The llms.txt file, MCP server, CLI and SDK install are adjacent machine-readable or programmatic surfaces, not an API specification, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
